VLC plays almost any IPTV stream, including MPEG-2, interlaced sports, teletext and multicast. If a stream won’t start, Plasma tries the next engine by itself.
mpv plays live TV with fine control of the picture, and can turn surround sound into Dolby Digital. If a stream won’t start, Plasma tries the next engine by itself.
The Android player plays Dolby Vision and HDR10+ the way the TV intends, and suits movies best. If a stream won’t start, Plasma tries the next engine by itself.

Step-by-step guide and adb commands for a computer
The steps for replacing Google TV Home, and the exact adb commands for this TV if you’d rather use a computer.
Three steps. Plasma pairs with this TV once, then does the rest.
In Settings › System › About, press OK on Android TV OS build seven times. Then turn on Developer options › Wireless debugging.
Choose Pair device with pairing code. While the code is on the TV, scan the QR code with your phone and type the code and port there.
Plasma becomes Home and turns off Google TV Home and its fallback.

# code and ports are on the Wireless debugging screen
To undo, run %1$s for the same two packages, or use Restore Google TV Home.
